diagnosis: The WebSocket endpoint authenticates the user via a query token and validates the existence of the support chat session. However, it fails to verify whether the connecting user is either the customer who initiated the session or the assigned support agent. Any authenticated user can join and intercept active support chat sessions or impersonate participants by specifying an arbitrary session_id.
